title: Dispatch FLE 7: Magistrate Orders Two Records for One Name
summary: The ruling preserves the burial and the living explorer’s identity.
topic: A Funeral for a Living Eidetician
author: Clara Vale, Staff Correspondent
paragraphs: The magistrate has accepted both sets of documents. The burial record will identify Miriam Voss of Kingsfen, with her dates and family. The Institute’s register will identify Dr. Miriam Voss of Alderwick, living, and include the expedition fork that links the accounts.

The ruling creates no general rule for other Stratum cases. It does permit Lydia to visit her mother’s grave without the city calling its occupant unknown. Dr. Voss has signed the entry acknowledging the other life.
